'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*2021–2022 Russian-Ukrainian crisis
**The [[United States]] rejects [[Russia]]'s demand that [[Ukraine]] be barred from joining [[NATO]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60145159 (BBC News)]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]], during a telephone conversation with [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]], says "the Russians could invade Ukraine in February". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60164537 (BBC News)]
*[[Spillover of the Syrian civil war]]
**[[Jordanian Armed Forces|Jordanian troops]] kill 27 "armed [[smuggler]]s" after they tried to cross [[Jordan–Syria border|the border]] from [[Syria]] with a large quantity of [[amphetamines]]. Several other smugglers, who were "supported by other armed groups", were wounded, according to a statement from the military. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/jordans-army-kills-27-drug-smugglers-trying-infiltrate-border-syria-statement-2022-01-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Dnipro shooting]]
**Five people are killed and five more are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Yuzhmash]] production facility in [[Dnipro]], Ukraine, after a member of the [[National Guard of Ukraine|Ukrainian National Guard]] opens fire. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-5-dead-after-serviceman-opens-fire-at-factory (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[2022 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes]]
**Two civilians are killed while 21 more people are wounded near [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|the border]] between [[Kyrgyzstan]] and [[Tajikistan]] after troops from both countries engage in a battle. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/28/guards-clash-again-on-kyrgyz-tajik-border-ceasefire-falters (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****[[Finland]] reports its first ten cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron sub-lineage]] named BA.2 sublineage in [[Southwest Finland]]. [https://yle.fi/news/3-12290302 (Yle News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 203,136 new [[COVID-19]] cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 9.2 million. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/germany-records-over-200-000-daily-covid-19-cases-for-1st-time/2486985 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the seventh consecutive day of 88,816 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 11,404,617. [https://apa.az/en/cis-countries/russia-records-another-88816-coronavirus-cases-crisis-center-366918/ (Azeri Press Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports its first two cases of the Omicron sub-lineage named BA.2 sublineage in [[Catalonia]]. [https://www.theolivepress.es/spain-news/2022/01/27/first-cases-of-new-ba-2-omricon-covid-19-variant-are-confirmed-in-spain/ (''The Olive Press'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 82,180 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours. [https://english.aawsat.com/home/article/3441491/turkey-logs-record-82180-new-covid-cases (''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Government of the United Kingdom|government]]'s Plan B restrictions, including mandatory usage of face masks on [[public transport]] and in shops, and usage of [[COVID passports in the United Kingdom|NHS COVID passports]] for large events are lifted in [[England]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-restrictions-eased-today-as-england-moves-out-of-plan-b-and-back-to-plan-a-12525816 (Sky News)]
***[[European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[European Medicines Agency]] conditionally approves the use of the [[Pfizer]] anti-COVID-19 oral drug [[Paxlovid]] for high-risk adult patients. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20220127-eu-s-drug-watchdog-conditionally-approves-pfizer-s-covid-19-pill (France 24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 228,954 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 24.7 million. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/international/brazil-s-daily-covid-19-caseload-rises-by-record-228-954-infections-122012800137_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***[[South Korea]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 14,518 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 777,497. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/south-koreas-daily-covid-19-cases-hit-record-high20220127075922/ (Asian News International)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Xiomara Castro]] is officially sworn in as the 56th [[President of Honduras]], making her [[Honduras|the country]]'s first [[List of elected and appointed female heads of state and government|female president]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/xiomara-castro-sworn-in-as-first-female-president-of-honduras-2734373 (AFP via NDTV)]
